assumptions: Use the frozen v1 timing comparison and the v2 train/validation sample-size scaling already recorded in the v2I draft. No retiming or candidate-count changes.
control_fit_schedule: Three representations (B, A_outer, B_outer) x three seeds for exactly one A-validation-selected configuration per architecture.

fit_schedule.conditional_control_slots: 270 slots are enumerated; only the 27 slots corresponding to the selected configuration per architecture execute.
fit_schedule.metadata: Fit the two fixed metadata/FOV controls; no tuning.
fit_schedule.selection: Exactly one configuration per architecture, using only the declared validation ranking rule and all three seeds.
fit_schedule.stage_1: 90 network fits on representation A: 12 ResNet50 configurations x 3 seeds; 12 ViT-B/16 configurations x 3 seeds; 6 custom CNN+Transformer configurations x 3 seeds.
fit_schedule.stage_2: Only after selection, execute 27 network control fits: selected architecture configuration x representations B/A_outer/B_outer x 3 matching seeds. The 9 selected A runs are reused, not repeated.

metadata_controls: Two fixed CPU fits per the frozen v2F metadata/FOV-only control; no tuning and not included in GPU-hour estimate.

runtime_estimate_gpu_hours.custom_component: planning proxy, not measured v2 runtime
